CREATE TABLE knowledge_folders (
    id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
    kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
    parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), 
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Knowledge base folder hierarchy for multi-level document organization'
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_folders_parent ON knowledge_folders (kind_id, parent_id)
ALTER TABLE knowledge_documents ADD COLUMN folder_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE knowledge_documents DROP COLUMN folder_id
